signal: Coherent, the logic-as-a-service company behind Coherent Spark, announced a collaboration with Seyna to embed its business-logic management into Seyna's full-stack insurance platform.

email.body1:
Rod, saw Coherent embed Spark's logic management into Seyna's insurance platform to speed brokers' time-to-market.

A partnership like that usually opens more in-market insurance and banking accounts than a team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Coherent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rod, quick follow-up for Coherent.

When a partnership expands the addressable market, most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to capture it. The gap surfaces late, and recovering a quarter is far harder than planning for it up front.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Coherent needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rod, last bit of proof for Coherent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Coherent's reply rate likely compares to peer enterprise-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rod, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A new partnership keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise-software motion? I'll tailor it to Coherent either way.
